why: YAML decodes escapes only inside double-quoted scalars, and its short escape for ESC is two characters that look like nothing on disk. The fail side is config/a.yml with that escape in a double-quoted value, which js-yaml turns into ESC (measured). The pass side is the same value single-quoted, where YAML keeps the backslash as text: a rule that matched the characters anywhere would fail every shell colour in a workflow run block, which is literal there too.
